expert_yaml:
skill: peg_channel
dsl_version: 2
skill_type: arm

phases:
  - id: align_behind_peg
    type: align
    generator: linear_cartesian
    control: position_control
    termination: pose_tolerance
    subtask_id: approach
    target:
      source: yaml
      anchor: task_object
      offset: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
      offset_along_axis:
        distance: 0.05
        axis: task_goal_direction
        mode: add_to_offset
        sign: negative
      tolerance: 0.01
      orientation: {mode: keep_current}

  - id: contact_peg
    type: contact
    generator: linear_cartesian
    control: force_threshold_switch
    termination: contact_detected
    subtask_id: contact
    target:
      source: yaml
      anchor: task_object
      offset: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
      offset_along_axis:
        distance: 0.022
        axis: task_goal_direction
        mode: add_to_offset
        sign: negative
      tolerance: 0.008
      orientation: {mode: keep_current}

  - id: traverse_channel
    type: push
    generator: impedance_motion
    control: impedance_control
    termination: pose_tolerance
    subtask_id: push
    target:
      source: yaml
      anchor: task_goal
      offset: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
      offset_along_axis:
        distance: 0.0175
        axis: task_goal_direction
        mode: add_to_offset
        sign: negative
      tolerance: 0.0103
      orientation: {mode: keep_current}
    parameters:
      trailing_contact_offset:
        type: scalar
        range: [0.0165, 0.0185]
        default: 0.0175
        binds_to:
          - {path: target.offset_along_axis.distance, mode: replace}
      traversal_speed:
        type: scalar
        range: [0.02, 0.06]
        default: 0.04
        binds_to:
          - {path: generator.speed, mode: replace}
    guards:
      - id: channel_force_limit
        when: during_phase
        predicate: force_below
        args: {scope: body_contact, body: peg}
        threshold: 40.0
        on_failure: retry
    retries:
      max_attempts: 1
      strategy: reduce_speed
      reduce_speed_factor: 0.5

  - id: retract_above_channel
    type: retract
    generator: linear_cartesian
    control: position_control
    termination: pose_tolerance
    target:
      source: yaml
      anchor: current_tcp
      offset: [0.0, 0.05, 0.20]
      tolerance: 0.02
      orientation: {mode: keep_current}
